entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane in chaos, where gods and mortals are pitted against each other and monsters stalk the land.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night sky realm of Theros, to which Elspeth travels.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels to Nyx with Ajani's support, kills Xenagos, and is killed by Heliod.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who, afraid of Elspeth's power, kills her.
